analysis.narrativeEn:

· Position vs SMA100 ($73,459.59)/SMA200 ($72,204.98): maintaining mid-to-long-term trend strength

[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): wait-and-see stance held for 5 days, consider bearish reversal if support ($80,659.81) breaks
